subject.title: fix(agents): keep compact tokens whole in keyed multi-question answers (#101722)

question: Should OpenClaw accept narrowing shipped keyed-answer syntax for `buildAgentHarnessUserInputAnswers` to whitespace-delimited `:`/`=` and no `-` delimiter to fix compact-token corruption?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct for the demonstrated corruption, but the helper is exported through the plugin SDK and the old delimiter behavior has shipped, so automation should not decide the compatibility contract alone.

options.title: Accept whitespace-delimited syntax
options.body: Land this PR once required checks finish, treating compact `key=value` and hyphen-delimited forms as unsupported accidental behavior.

options.title: Preserve legacy delimiters narrowly
options.body: Ask for a question-aware parser that keeps old compact or hyphen forms only when unambiguous and covered by compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Accept whitespace-delimited syntax
recommendation.body: Land this PR once required checks finish, treating compact `key=value` and hyphen-delimited forms as unsupported accidental behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the shared parser/SDK surface and already weighed in on the linked issue's acceptable repair boundary.
